headline: CDMO influence continues to grow; significant capex to keep the momentum

highlights: The current reactor capability stands at ~9000 KL. • Q2FY27 Revenue Segmentation: Generic API (includes ARV API, Oncology API and Other APIs)– 28%; Generic FDF – 31%; CDMO – 39%; Laurus bio - 2%. • The company has also invested in new edge technologies such as Cell therapies, Gene therapies and other advanced technologies.
Result Performance & Investment Rationale: • Q 2FY2 7 – Significant traction in CDMO continue to boost numbers : Revenues stood at ₹2206 crore, reflecting a ~33% YoY growth.
EBITDA stood at ₹750 crore with a margin of 34%, marking a significant improvement of 962 basis points YoY mainly due to 314 bps YoY improvement in GPM to 63%.

PAT stood ₹437 crore, driven by a favourable product mix and improving operational leverage. • Long term prospects remain robust : The CDMO growth for the quarter was phenomenal due to higher contribution from late-stage clinical projects and commercial API supplies and strong recurring business from existing relationships.
valuation: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Laurus Labs (LAULAB) CMP: ₹2215 Target ₹ 2550 (15%) Target Period: 12 months November 17, 2026 CDMO influence continues to grow; significant capex to keep the momentum… About the stock : Laurus Labs operates in the segment of generic APIs & FDFs (formulations), custom synthesis (CDMO) and biotechnology.
Rating and Target Price : We maintain our BUY rating with target price is ₹ 2555 based on 38 x FY29E EBITDA of ₹3686 crore .
We believe the premium valuation is justifiable based on the quest for sustained capex drive and success of delivering strong numbers on a consistent basis.
